mysql_blob_bytes.label: MySQL BLOB column capacity
mysql_blob_bytes.statement: A BLOB column in MySQL holds a maximum of 65,535 bytes.
mysql_blob_bytes.source: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual, String Type Storage Requirements
mysql_blob_bytes.caveat: Airflow's own documentation gives no numeric ceiling for an XCom value. It says XComs are for small amounts of data and that the default backend stores them in the metadata database, so what actually bounds the payload is that database's column. This figure is the MySQL case, not a statement about every deployment.

airflow_xcom_guidance.label: Airflow guidance on XCom size
airflow_xcom_guidance.statement: XComs are only designed for small amounts of data; do not use them to pass around large values, like dataframes.
airflow_xcom_guidance.source: Apache Airflow documentation, Core Concepts, XComs

x_api_recent_search_window_days.label: Recent search lookback
x_api_recent_search_window_days.statement: The recent search endpoint returns Posts from the last seven days.
x_api_recent_search_window_days.source: X API v2 documentation, Recent search

x_api_recent_search_max_results.label: Recent search page size
x_api_recent_search_max_results.statement: max_results accepts a value between 10 and 100 per request, with pagination for more.
x_api_recent_search_max_results.source: X API v2 documentation, Recent search
